summary: Harmony Gold Mining Company Limited filed a Form 6-K announcing changes to its Nomination Committee composition and the appointment of a Lead Independent Director. Mr Frans Lombard was appointed as Chairperson of the Nomination Committee and Lead Independent Director, effective August 14, 2026, succeeding Dr Mavuso Msimang, who remains a committee member. The announcement is a routine corporate governance update made in accordance with JSE Listings Requirements, with no special-situation event such as a merger, tender offer, or strategic review. No financial terms, deal mechanics, or risk-arb considerations apply. The filing is informational only, with no shareholder action required.
